title: How to Job Search in 2024? Use Multiple Job Boards
description:
Wondering how to job search in 2022? Use multiple job boards. Often job seekers look at just LinkedIn, or just Indeed—but there are lots of jobs that get listed on one job board and not another. Here's how to job search across multiple sites and keep all of your saved jobs organized in one tracker.

00:00 Introduction
00:30 How to search for jobs on LinkedIn
01:31 Finding open jobs on Indeed
02:08 Job searching using Glassdoor
02:57 How to find roles on Built In's job board
03:35 Using Google to search for jobs
04:54 Time-saving trick for searching multiple job boards
05:12 How to save jobs from all the job boards in one place
08:17 Wrap-up & Conclusion
